title: The most accurate load forecast is not the most valuable: a pre-specified study of battery peak shaving under demand charges in 462 buildings
highlights: Pre-specified test, 462 buildings: MAE did not rank load forecasts by savings
Under-forecasts set new demand peaks; over-forecasts of the same size cost little
Open loop, the most accurate forecast raised the bill in 83% of buildings
Value rose with the forecast quantile level (0.5 to 0.95) while accuracy fell
A real-time peak guard mattered more than the choice of forecaster
